Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent Indian chemical company headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Over the years, the company has established itself as a significant player in the manufacturing of aliphatic amines, amine derivatives, and specialty chemicals, serving a wide range of industrial applications. With a strong focus on quality, process efficiency, and continuous innovation, Balaji Amines has built a reputation for supplying reliable chemical solutions to customers in India and international markets.

The company caters to diverse sectors such as pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, water treatment, rubber chemicals, dyes, and other industrial segments where high-performance chemical intermediates are essential. Its product portfolio is supported by advanced manufacturing capabilities, technical expertise, and a commitment to maintaining strict environmental and safety standards. This combination has helped Balaji Amines earn the trust of customers seeking consistency, scalability, and technical support.

Balaji Amines Limited also reflects the growth of India’s specialty chemical industry, where companies are increasingly focusing on backward integration, sustainable production methods, and value-added products. From its base in Solapur, the company continues to contribute to industrial development, employment generation, and the strengthening of the domestic chemical supply chain. With an emphasis on operational excellence and market responsiveness, Balaji Amines remains an important name in the chemical manufacturing landscape of India.
